claims: The Cardinal Health Retail Business Conference (RBC) 2026 is scheduled to take place from July 22-25, 2026.
The Cardinal Health Retail Business Conference (RBC) 2026 is scheduled to take place at the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando, Florida.
The Cardinal Health Retail Business Conference (RBC) 2026 brings together independent pharmacy customers, suppliers, and industry experts for networking, education, and professional development.
The Rosen Plaza Hotel (9700 International Dr) is the exhibitor hotel.
